description: An expander for Pole Dancer that draws the filter response that module is working with; it goes immediately to the right of it

params.text: Sets how much of the plot is shown: narrow, mid or wide
Chooses what the screen draws: Bode, the magnitude and phase against frequency, or Pole/Zero, the roots on the s-plane

notes: with no Pole Dancer immediately to its left this module reads nothing and the screen shows an empty plot
the mix and feedback figures it plots are sent over from the Pole Dancer; they have no controls on this panel and nothing here changes them
the plot is refreshed on a divided clock rather than every sample, so fast movement in the topology signal is smoothed over
